{{Top|leg}}
'''Go''' was a type of drink. At some point after the succession of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a number of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] queued above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], waiting for permission to depart from the world. [[Borrath Freelan]], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of one of the ships, drank a cup of Go while he waited.
